== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Mister Goss, also known as Goss, served as a navigator on a ship. He was characterized by a tall, gaunt, and skeletal appearance that many found unsettling. His personality was marked by extreme nervousness, frequent tics, and a high-pitched manner of speaking. During a confrontation involving creatures known as [[Elderspawn]], he was seen struggling against multiple climbing organisms and later appeared physically injured and covered in blood while attempting to assist [[Miss Lakiri|Lakiri]]. Following these events, he was seen heavily bandaged and displaying signs of intense psychological distress and anger. He possessed a key crafted from dark, bone-like material. Despite his fragile state, he was eventually discovered deceased in his sleeping quarters, a death noted for its potential connection to the mystery of a crown.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Mister Goss possesses a skeletally thin frame. His body is covered in bandages and was stained with blood during the battle.}}

== Of Kings and Killers ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Mister Goss served as a navigator and crew member aboard the ship. During a battle, he was seen covered in blood while providing accounts of an explosion. Despite his skeletally thin frame being wrapped in bandages, he did not survive the events of the journey.}}
